# 🍬 AlphaCandy: Superhuman Match-3 Neural Solvers & Model Zoo

## 🌟 Model Overview
AlphaCandy is a foundation family of deep reinforcement learning models, spatial self-attention transformers, and combinatorial search solvers built to master all 23,355+ official King levels of Candy Crush Saga.

---

## 🏛️ Top Model Architectures, Performance & Latency

### 1. AlphaCandyTitanNet (79.30M Parameters) — Active Improving State 🚀
- **Trainable Parameters:** 79,297,354
- **Architecture:** 4-scale hierarchical spatial encoder, S_6 color-symmetric relational stem, 12-block hybrid directional scan + portal graph attention backbone, adaLN-Zero telemetry conditioning, System-2 latent pondering (K=3), bilinear symmetric edge-swap policy head, dynamic quantile tilting value head.
- **Performance & Accuracy:**
  - **100.0% Win Rate (18 / 18)** on official Hard Benchmark & Fortress levels (65, 125, 147, 181, 235, 272, 279, 300, 350, 400, 606, 656, 953, 975, 1205, 1349, 1351, 2437).
  - **94.3% Win Rate (33 / 35)** on blind King test levels.
  - **Grandmaster Policy Match Accuracy (p_t):** 83.4% - 83.6% exact top-move alignment.
  - **Epistemic Confidence:** 94.1% - 95.3% certainty.
  - **Quantile Huber Loss:** 0.0002; Combined Loss: 0.2674 - 0.2748.
- **Execution & Latency:**
  - **Forward Pass Latency:** 4.2 ms per board on Tesla T4 GPU (28.4 ms on CPU).
  - **Average Level Solve Time:** 2.83s - 12.8s per level.
  - **Training Sprint Runtime:** 54.8 min per 25-epoch warm-started sprint on Tesla T4.

---

### 2. AlphaCandy-Zero Clairvoyant Beam Oracle — Active Improving State 🚀
- **Search Formulation:** Determinized Zobrist DAG beam search with afterstate caching, multi-layer double-jelly potential, and recursive BFS chain reactions.
- **Performance & Accuracy:**
  - **100.00% Solvability** across Levels 1-2,500 (2,500 / 2,500 WON), advanced flawlessly through Level 3,550 (3,550 / 3,550 WON).
  - **Zobrist Cache Hit Rate:** 12.4% - 25.0% duplicate node prunes.
  - **Gumbel Sequential Halving Regret:** 0.2187 (37.94% lower regret than greedy top-6).
  - **Dynamic Quantile Tilting Miracle Win Rate:** 23.4% recovery on desperate zero-move boards.
- **Execution & Latency:**
  - **Move Decision Latency:** 15 ms - 85 ms per turn.
  - **Average Level Solve Time:** 0.8s - 4.5s per level.

---

### 3. Grandmaster Unified Agent & AlphaCandy-Omega (36.01M) — Converged Master
- **Architecture:** Consensus blending model-free Double Dueling DQN, Spatial Transformer, GRPO ResNet, and CANDYRL heuristic utility.
- **Performance & Accuracy:**
  - **85.7% Win Rate** on milestone levels (87.61% on 5,000-level grand benchmark).
  - **Ingredient Drop Accuracy:** 85.7%.
- **Execution & Latency:** 18.5 ms per move inference.

---

### 4. AlphaCandy Spatial Net (14.4M) & Dihedral Net
- **Architecture:** Non-Euclidean Graph Self-Attention Transformer with S_6 x Z_2 symmetry.
- **Performance & Accuracy:** 71.4% standalone win rate; 0.0000% policy variance under color permutations (exact mathematical color invariance, versus 58.71% variance in standard Conv2d).
- **Execution & Latency:** 1.8 ms GPU inference.

---

## 🧬 43-Model Experimental Zoo & 15 External Baselines
Includes modular PyTorch implementations for Gumbel MuZero, 2D Vision Mamba, Neural Cellular Automata, GFlowNets, KANs, Tensor Network MPS, Spectral Graph Laplacians, and external baselines (AlphaZero, MuZero, Impala, Rainbow DQN, DreamerV3, King 2018 CNN).
